decision: C1/R1/D1 are resolved. No remaining source blocker found in this bounded collector/decoder review. Source review gate clears for the exact revision002 bytes below; SDK, packet binding and hardware execution remain separate root-owned gates. Old collector001/SDK attempts are not substituted.

bindings.archive001: Every file in collector-native/revisions/001 matches its original frozen receipt; decoder-revisions/001 code/tests match decoder-source-001. Original provisional review preserved.

resolved_findings.result: C success now requires all four saved final power and all five saved final clock guard words to pass the unchanged survey.c predicates. Noncoherence across read times does not excuse a failed individual saved final guard. Nine mutated final-field cases are rejected. Wrapper/header unchanged.

Both validators require the freshly read NOT_READY field to fail at the exact stopping position, reject unreachable DLS_LIMIT for this frozen 889-read profile, and reject a later stop following an already-failed page-shift/lock/stream check. Other partial/stale guard fields remain unconstrained. Legitimate partial records still classify as refusals.

Decoder requires provider first, optional equal instance second, verdict last. It rejects records after verdict, verdict before provider, swapped copies, duplicate records and wrong nonce/digest/indices.

source_review.mig_abi: Generated device_user.h from iy73f9hyr3hcq2n1yhmbsyx2pkmblw09 has from_path(main_port, io_string_t, mach_port_t*) and get_property_bytes(entry, io_name_t, io_struct_inband_t, mach_msg_type_number_t*). Collector calls these exact three/four-argument forms, with a4096-byte count and buffer. No CF-shaped API substitution.
source_review.kernel_contract: Pinned device.defs:198-217 and IOUserClient.cpp:3432-3461,3708-3776: success+null means absent path; raw property bytes are copied inband; missing property is kIOReturnNoResources; insufficient capacity/MIG failures stay errors; actual successful length is returned.
source_review.missing_vs_refused: Collector only classifies a well-formed kernel snapshot as SAMPLED/REFUSED. Missing provider or MIG failures exit1, with no optional instance read. Frozen decoder rejects missing data, COPY errors, truncation and malformed snapshots rather than relabeling them a hardware refusal.
source_review.optional_instance: Absence is allowed because the refused diagnostic service may detach. A present instance requires a successful byte-identical property copy; missing property, MIG failure or difference disqualifies. Provider data is required regardless.
source_review.read_only_calls: Unchanged collector_main.c calls IOMasterPort once, fixed registry path/property reads at most twice, and IOObjectRelease. No IOServiceOpen, IOConnect, iteration/retry, MMIO, mapping, device-tree/registry mutation or device writes.
source_review.cleanup: Each obtained entry send right is released after the property call, including errors. Inband buffers are static and bounded, no OOL allocation. The finite process retains the main-port right until process exit; this is a bounded process-lifetime ownership limitation, not a persistent kernel-resource leak. No user-client lifetime exists.
source_review.transport: Lowercase48 nonce; 764-byte V1 valid record; fixed64-byte indexed chunks with last60; SHA256 and exact byte counts; provider/optional instance ordering; numeric verdict/raw agreement; initialization_proven=false. Malformed input bytes remain emitted privately before MALFORMED/exit1. Output flush/error forces exit1.
source_review.evidence_scope: Successful sampling is noncoherent numeric observation only. Neither exit0 nor node presence proves DART initialization, ownership, translation, safe DMA or device function. Actual process/host completion must accompany decoded serial data.

independent_checks.freeze_verification: Recomputed all final file hashes and sorted collector source-set hash; checked both original archives unchanged. C core and decoder hashes match the independent cross-validator run.

Actual target MIG/property path, provider retention and raw snapshot are runtime unknowns until an authorized finite run. Preserve failures and mandatory Linux recovery; do not turn missing registry data into an observation.
